parsed.note_claim: SynthIDは電子透かしの一種で、画像や音楽、動画ファイルに人間にはわからないように情報を埋め込むステガノグラフィである。
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: SynthID embeds digital watermarks directly into AI-generated images, audio, text or video. The watermarks are embedded across generative AI consumer products, and are imperceptible to humans – but can be detected by SynthID's technology.
parsed.reason: The page directly describes SynthID as a digital watermarking tool that embeds imperceptible watermarks into AI-generated images, audio, text, and video, substantiating the note's claim about SynthID being a form of steganographic digital watermarking.
